module.purpose: Implements tracking and unwrapping of Thenables (promises) for React Suspense inside the reconciler, including suspension, lazy component resolution, and dev warnings about misuse of use().
module.summary: This module manages the integration of promises (thenables) with React's Suspense mechanism during reconciliation. It defines the ThenableState structure (dev/prod variants), functions to create and track thenables used while rendering, and to suspend the work loop by throwing opaque exceptions. It also handles lazy component initialization, detects infinite ping loops from uncached promises, and provides development-only warnings for conditional use of use() and for catching Suspense exceptions in userspace. The module exposes helpers to retrieve the suspended thenable after a throw and to check for improper async catch blocks that would leak internal exceptions.
module.businessContext: React rendering internals; supports Suspense for data fetching and lazy loading. If broken, components won't suspend correctly, causing hangs, warnings, or crashes.

units.name: checkIfUseWrappedInTryCatch

detail.name: checkIfUseWrappedInTryCatch
preconditions: Only active in __DEV__ builds; in production the function unconditionally returns false.
Requires that needsToResetSuspendedThenableDEV was set to true immediately before the SuspenseException was thrown and has not yet been cleared by proper boundary handling.
postconditions: In __DEV__: if needsToResetSuspendedThenableDEV was truthy on entry, it is set to false and the function returns true.
In all other cases (flag falsy or __DEV__ false), the function returns false without side effects.
invariants: needsToResetSuspendedThenableDEV is reset to false if and only if it was truthy on entry and this function returned true.
A single true return consumes the flag: repeated calls after a true return will yield false until the flag is set again.
edgeCases: When needsToResetSuspendedThenableDEV is falsy/null in __DEV__: returns false with no state mutation.
When __DEV__ is false (production build): returns false immediately without reading or mutating the flag.
When called multiple times in succession while the flag is set: the first call returns true and resets the flag; all subsequent calls return false until the flag is re-set.
stateMutations: needsToResetSuspendedThenableDEV is set to false when it was truthy on entry
detail.summary: Detects whether a React 'use' expression was incorrectly wrapped in a userspace try/catch during development, returning true if the suspended-thenable reset flag was left uncleared — indicating the SuspenseException was caught by user code rather than React's own boundary handling.

specTests.then: returns true and needsToResetSuspendedThenableDEV is set to false
returns false with no state mutation

detail.signature: export function checkIfUseWasUsedBefore(unsuspendedFiber: Fiber, thenableState: null | ThenableState): void

postconditions: If the last suspended fiber matches the current unsuspended fiber's key path and thenableState is not null, resets lastSuspendedFiber and lastSuspendedStack to null

didIssueUseWarning prevents multiple console.error calls for the same suspicious pattern change
lastSuspendedFiber and lastSuspendedStack are always reset to null after evaluation

When enableConditionalUseWarning is false, the entire function body is skipped
When lastSuspendedFiber is null, the function does nothing
When areSameKeyPath returns false between lastSuspendedFiber and unsuspendedFiber, the function does nothing
When thenableState is not null, the state is treated as acceptable and cleared silently
